title: Executive Overview Dashboard

interactions.student_multi_filter: Native multi-select filters for entry academic year, entry month, entry fiscal year, and calculated study year apply as an AND intersection; multiple selected values in the same control apply as OR.
interactions.domain_filter: Mobility, research, and investment support year filtering; mobility and investment also support month filtering.
interactions.yoy: Mobility and research compare the selected/latest year to the prior year; investment compares the latest selected report to the previous report. Current personnel and current students show an unavailable comparison when an equivalent prior snapshot is absent.

calculated_fields.study_year: current academic year - entry year + 1; over four years is labeled เกิน 4 ปี
calculated_fields.entry_fiscal_year: entry year + 1 for October through December; otherwise entry year

data_labels: Personnel KPIs count only current roster records with status ปกติ; currency values in the investment view use THB formatting.
